collision_policy.stale_rule: Active claims expire at expires_at unless renewed by a new commit, workflow run, artifact, receipt, or explicit BLOCKED state with machine-observable release condition.
collision_policy.missing_evidence_rule: Missing evidence is BLOCKED, RETRY, or FAILED; never COMPLETE.
collision_policy.coordination_rule: Repository records and workflows, not chat sessions, own continuation.

claims.release_condition: All local stack stages pass hosted validation and immutable artifact evidence is retained.
claims.collision_boundaries: No competing implementation may reinterpret provider prompt deltas as isolated StegGate cost or replace burden-class metrics with one universal surcharge without a new versioned schema.

claims.release_condition: Release COMPLETE when both DeepSeek raw and DeepSeek/StegVerse produce the required normalized outcome with retained provider response hashes and price-card binding. Remain BLOCKED if DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is absent; RETRY on transient provider/network failure; FAILED on non-equivalent output after the bounded execution attempt.
expected_evidence: required and actual normalized output hashes
versioned DeepSeek V4 Flash price-card hash
claims.collision_boundaries: This lane owns only DeepSeek lanes 6 and 7. It must not rewrite historical five-lane results or the OpenAI/Anthropic evidence lineage.
claims.machine_observable_blocker: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY missing from the authorized GitHub Actions environment

claims.claimant: repository-native integration lane after DeepSeek pair COMPLETE
expected_evidence: DeepSeek pair incorporated without changing comparison contract
claims.collision_boundaries: May consume DeepSeek pair evidence but may not edit its raw provider receipts.
claims.next_task_after_release: Evaluate bounded publication candidate and remote-burden dependency.

claims.claimant: unclaimed pending named authorized remote service
claims.release_condition: A repository-visible integration contract identifies an authorized policy/delegation/KMS/persistence/network service endpoint and test authority.
claims.collision_boundaries: Do not invent remote services or relabel local socket/file/SQLite/HMAC approximations as production remote evidence.
claims.next_task_after_release: Replace one local burden class at a time and rerun product/workload envelopes.

claims.claimant: destination handoff selected only after publication admission
claims.release_condition: Canonical DeepSeek evidence and required production-burden evidence produce an admitted bounded publication candidate; then destination handoffs are re-read immediately before mutation.
claims.collision_boundaries: No downstream mutation while publication is NOT_ADMITTED.
claims.next_task_after_release: Propagate only bounded claims and verify downstream ingestion.
